audience: engineering teams that build and deploy with Semaphore CI pipelines

useCases.title: Find out why a job failed
useCases.text: Get the pipeline to see its blocks and jobs. Read the log of the failed job to see the command output and exit codes.

useCases.title: Browse the pipelines and workflows of a project
useCases.text: List the pipelines of a project, filtered by branch and time. Open a workflow to see its commit, branch and trigger.

useCases.title: Track flaky tests and pipeline reliability
useCases.text: List the flaky tests below a pass-rate threshold on a branch. Read the pass rate of one pipeline file over time.

useCases.title: Check running agents and deployment history
useCases.text: List the running agents and the self-hosted agent types. Read the deployment history of a target: who deployed what, and when.

useCases.title: Rebuild failed parts or stop a running job
useCases.text: Rebuild only the failed and blocked parts of a pipeline, which uses machine time. Or stop one running job, which then cannot resume.
